title: Who Says La ilaaha illa-Llah Is Muslim
body:
Dastoor yaa Sultanu 'l-Awliyaa.
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, `Azeez Allah!
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Kareem Allah!
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Subhaan Allah!
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Sultaan Allah!
Zid habeebika yaa Rabbi 'l-`izzati wa 'l-`azhaamati wa 'l-jabaroot, `izzan wa sharafan, nooran wa suroora,
ridwaanan wa sultaana. Zid yaa Rabbana ibaadika 's-saliheen nooran wa suroora. Yaa Rabbana ighfir lana
maa mada yaa waasiya 'l-karami. Anzil `alayna 'l-ghaitha suqyaa rahmatin, wa la taj`alna min al-qaaniteen.
Ghaythan, mugheethan, haniyyan, mariyyan, saigh'an, ghamman, tabaqan, daa'ima! Yadhhab bihi zhulmatu
'l-kufr wa khid`aata kullu Shaytan, `alayhim maa yastahiqoon. Alfu salaat, alfu salaam `alayka yaa Sayyidi 'lawwaleen wa’l-akhireen. Wa `ala man ittabi`aka bi ihsaanin ila yawmi 'd-deen! (Mawlana Shaykh stands.)
Yaa Sayyidee, yaa RasoolAllah, yaa Habeebullah. (Mawlana Shaykh sits.)
As-salaamu `alaykum, attenders who are attending! May Rabbu 'l-`izzah, Allah Almighty grant the attenders
to be His weak servants. Kun taaliban, “Be a student.” The Seal of Prophets (s) is saying, "You must ask." And
we are saying, a`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytani 'r-Rajeem, because we are asking for goodness, but Shaytan

is quickly running to change our good intentions and efforts. Therefore, we must say, a`oodhu billahi min
ash-Shaytani 'r-Rajeem.
O our Lord! It is from our good adab, good manners to first address Allah Almighty. (Mawlana Shaykh
stands) Subhaana wa t`aala. O Allah! (Mawlana Shaykh sits.) When you are addressing Allah Almighty,
everything is fee ghaayatu 'l-ist`adaad (alert, prepared), at the last point of being ready. When servants say,
a`oodhu billah, quickly the muwakkaloon, angels appointed on this planet, take a state of ta'ahub, alertness,
because the servant is calling the Lord of Heavens! They immediately become prepared and alert because
they are ashamed that a servant is calling Rabbu 'l-`izzah, Allah Almighty, and he may be in a very difficult
and frightful position. Therefore, they are quickly asking, a`oodhu billah; that is the adab from a servant to
his Creator, Allah Almighty. And angels become alert quickly, as much as possible, to meet his needs. They
see the shaytans are trying to put the servant in their trap, so they quickly run and take them away.
Therefore, anyone afraid of falling in a bad condition must say, a`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytani 'r-Rajeem
and the angels become alert even before Allah Almighty may order, "Why are you not looking after my
servant?"
O our Attenders! As-salaamu `alaykum. We are saying, a`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytani 'r-Rajeem. Shaytan
is seeing so many attenders and saying, "Enough, everyday you hear that one repeating, repeating, repeating.
No need, you heard it once already, it is enough!! Look at what is important for you today; how is this
important?!" We know, what can be more important than such an association or meeting? But Shaytan is
trying to make this assembly to be of no value. Every day you are here; yes, you must attend because
sometimes you can find some jewels. For example, if there is an auction where everything is going to be sold
and a customer goes to that auction all the time, he will not say, "It doesn't matter today, I am tired, I won't
go," because his ego will say, "No, you must go!" Because Shaytan comes and says, "No, even if you are busy
or tired, you must go because there may be a precious diamond or jewel there today which you may lose," and
so that one runs there.
And there is no doubt that I am not sitting here on my order; I am a slave, a servant to my master, and my
master is making me to sit here and say, "We are sending to you something from heavenly jewels. Call people
and offer it." Therefore, Shaytan may say to so many people, "Everyday why you are going and sitting?" And
every day for dunya, for auctions, not everyday, every morning and evening, you are going to auctions,

running for a stone. What is bringing to you that stone, putting it in a safe and ignoring the value of this
meeting on Earth? They are heedless people and slaves of Shaytan with no naseeb, and they are losing their
chance! If every hour is going to be such an auction, people will run to take something from this dunya. What
about this gathering, is it not for dunya? This is something asking to teach people how they should be dealing
with heavenly ones, how they should deal with the Seal of Prophets (s), and then this is a humble assembly, a
humble meeting whose main target is to find such a precious diamond that makes our Lord happy with us.
What is that precious jewel that we must try to reach? What is that?
O `ulamas! Say, Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem! Say and believe that Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem is
opening every locked entrance or every store, or every treasure, here and Hereafter! Anything wrong? Who
among Salafi `ulamas is saying this? You are not saying this; you are just claiming to be "Salafi `ulamas."
Why are you not saying what the Salafi `ulamas were advising and saying to people? You should be saying,
"O People! For treasures on Earth and in the heavens, use heavenly keys. O Muslims! O Believers! If you wish
to know the key for every locked treasure here and in the Hereafter, it just opens with the key of Bismillahi 'rRahmani 'r-Raheem, Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem, Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem." (Mawlana Shaykh
stands and sits.) Anything wrong? No one can say what we are saying is wrong; that is the reality! Therefore,
the Lord of Heavens is putting Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem at the beginning of 114 surahs, except one.
I never heard our doctors, or Salafi `ulamas or other `ulamas, or learned ones call people, saying, "O People!
I am reminding you that the most important thing for your lives, guaranteed here and Hereafter, is to call
'yaa Fattaah, yaa Fattaah, yaa Fattaah.'" And Fattaah, He is Almighty, Allahu akbar. (Mawlana Shaykh
stands.) Yaa Fattaah iftaah lana, (Mawlana Shaykh sits.) to make kufr down and to open countless treasures
for here and Hereafter. Why are you not writing books and why are you not saying this every Jumu`ah?
Every Jumu`ah you only know to say, kullu muhdathatin bid`atun wa kullu bid`atun dalaala wa kullu
dalaalatun fi 'n-naar. You have learned only this? Not to say, Bismillahi 'r- Rahmaani 'r -Raheem?
O People! That opens all treasures through this life and all treasures appointed by the Lord of Heavens to His
servants. Why are you not saying? Instead every Jumu`ah you are saying on the minbar of the Holy Prophet
(s), "O People! kullu muhdathatin bid`atun wa kullu bid`atun dalaala wa kullu dalaalatun fi 'n-naar “Every
innovation is heresy and every heresy is misguidance and every misguidance leads to Hellfire.” Why don't you
say how we can protect ourselves from falling into that bid`a? Why are you not saying that to forget to say

Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem, is amrun muhdath and he who is forgetting Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'rRaheem, is going to be ahlu 'l-dalalah, ahlu 'l-bid`a and ahlu 'l-bid`atun fi 'n-naar? You Wahabis are learning
some things only! But those that are responsible for protecting Islam are now beginning to move against
everyone whose words and claims and beliefs are wrong. The first ones are those that are trying to change
`aqeedatu 'l-Islam, and are saying, "Accept Wahabi beliefs. All other people are on the wrong way and they
are going to the Fire!”
O Wahabis and Wahabi `ulamas! Who is giving you the authority to say this and accuse billions of Muslims
of bid`a and to go to the Fire and the remaining handful of Wahabis are going to Jannah, and others of the
ummah to the Fire? MashaaAllah, who gave you this authority?
And Allah Almighty (Mawlana Shaykh stands.) is saying:
•••••••• ••••••• •••••••••• •••••••••••••
alaysa'Llahu bi ahkami 'l- haakimeen, Is Allah not the wisest of Judges? (95:8)
(Mawlana Shaykh sits.) And if a person places his hands on the screen of the Prophet's tomb you say, "Shirk!
Bid`a! Kufr! Go away!" You are making the biggest wrong! The Seal of Prophets (s) said, Al-halaalu bayyin wa
'l-haraamu bayyin. "Halaal (what is permitted) is clear and haraam (what is forbidden) is clear." With which
verse of the Qur'an, or which hadith are you saying, "This is haraam and he who does this will be a kaafir or a
mushrik." By saying this you are being the haakim, judge in Islam. The Wahabis are doing this and are not
fearing or ashamed of accusing Muslims, saying they are mushrik or kaafir or people of bid`a. Who is giving
you the authority?
Allah Almighty says, Alays-Allahu bi ahkami 'l-hakimeen. That is ayatu 'l-kareema, do you not understand it?
How you are giving that hukum? How are you going to be the judge of the Muslim Ummah? And the Prophet
(s) is saying, "He, who says La ilaaha illa-Llah is Muslim." And even Allah (swt) is saying in His Holy Qur'an,
(Mawlana Shaykh stands.)
••••• •••••••••• •••••• ••••••• •••••••••• •••••••••• •••••• •••••••••
Wa laa taqooloo liman alqaa ilaykumu 's-salaama lasta mu'minan, Say not to any one who offers you a
salutation, "You are not a believer." (4:94)

And Wahabi people, you are Arabs! Allah Almighty is never happy that you accuse a person who is saying assalaamu `alaykum of being a kaafir! Wa laa taqooloo liman alqaa ilaykumu 's-salaama lasta mu'minan. What
is that?! Are you not ashamed and not fearing Allah and His Rasool?!! (Mawlana Shaykh sits.)
May Allah forgive me. We must be Defenders of Truth! Not Wahabis, but Ahl as-Sunnah wal Jam`aat are
Defenders of Truth! But our `ulamas are shirdhimatun qaleelaa khawwafahum, are fearing from a handful of
people. Because our `ulamas are also running after dunya; they are not real `ulamas. Why are they not saying
what is haqq? Al haqqu yaalu wa la yu' laa `alayh. Why are they not speaking to them? We are Ajam. Nabi (s)
Arabiyyun, wa mab`ooth li 'l-`arab wa 'l-`ajam. Ours is our tribal language, but you know Arabic and are
studying, yet you are accusing Muslims, lasta mu'minan!?!! Allah Almighty is never happy if a person is
saying, As-salaamu `alaykum, and it is said to them, "You are not Muslim." And Allah Almighty is never
happy with that one who is killing a person who says to him, As-salaamu `alaykum. Where is Islam? You are
thinking Islam is coming under your inhisaar (confinement), that Islam is only what you know!
You are blocking whole knowledge, and only the knowledge that you know to be Islam and your
understanding from the beginning up to the end is wrong. Where are Al-Azhar `ulamas to defend Islam
against Wahabi wolves? There are shirdhimatun qaleela. There are a handful of people who are Wahabi. We
are defenders of truth. We are not Salafi, but we are defenders of truth and the first defender of truth is
Sayyidina Muhammad (s) from pre-Eternal up to Eternal (Mawlana Shaykh stands and sits.) And you must
know that Islam and Muslim communities are never going to be saved unless they are bringing the real
understanding of Islam, taken from them the haybat glory. The glory is taken away because they are following
and fearing from a handful of people. Why? Are they two-billion Muslims? Wahabi groups are trying to
change their beliefs, trying to change their most high respects to the most respected one in Creation,
Sayyidina Muhammad (s)! (Mawlana Shaykh stands.) Raghman `ala anfihim raghman `ala anfihim! We are
standing up against their beliefs! We are giving our high respects to Sayyidina Muhammad (s)!!! (Mawlana
Shaykh sits.) May Allah forgive us.
O `ulamas! You have a heavy responsibility. I am addressing, and I am the weakest servant. I have a right to
call to you and to say to you, or to accuse you, Azhari `ulamas. First of all, why are they not defending the
truth about Islam against those Wahabi people? Allah Almighty and His beloved one are going to ask you on

the Day of Resurrection, Judgment Day. O shirdhimatun qaleelan, a handful of people, that are trying to
change beliefs of Ahlu’l-Sunnah wa’l-Jama`ah coming here. Who was commanding you, teaching you such
baatil, false beliefs? Who was making you attack the big mass of Muslims, saying, “You are all in haraam, you
are all in shirk!” Who gives you that authority?
May Allah forgive us. Qul Allah wa laa tubaali, “Say 'Allah' and do not care.” If we are wrong, I may call them
to a place, and what the Seal of Prophets (s) did with nasaara ul najraan mubahala, I am ready. If I am wrong,
fire from the heavens will come on me and burn me. If they are wrong, it will come on them. Mubahala, I am
ready! Anywhere, in front of Ka`aba mu`aazam, in front of the Seal of Prophets (s), I am ready. If they have
such a thing in their heart, shaja'a, courage, I am ready. SubhaanAllah, rijaalAllah, rijaalAllah agheethoona
bi-fadlillah. They are not believing in rijaalAllah, they are believing in the rijaal of Shaytan! May Allah forgive
us.
Fatihah.
(Mawlana Shaykh prays two raka`ats Salaat ash-Shukr.)
(44 minutes) Oh, too much. Alhamdulillah.
